scope: Offline HTML prototype only; not native-app acceptance

checks.name: five tabs and a single-row source switcher
copy reference → paste into draft → send with a clickable card
copying a path clears the previous typed resource reference
read-only PC resources cannot be renamed
workspace and mount navigation keep different sources separate
plugin install state dynamically changes creator entries
create validates the name, creates once and opens the resource
canceling an in-progress prototype create does not leave a resource
rename local resource and remove recent with undo
no handler is reported rather than pretending to play a video
empty and error states have working recovery actions
long press opens the same resource menu
sheet uses modal semantics, traps focus and restores the triggering control
320 / 390 / 430px: themes and languages do not overflow the viewport
